description: Na₄SeO₅ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are nine inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-33°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.68 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-35°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.64 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-21°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.83 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-35°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.69 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-26°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.38 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.48 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-33°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.81 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SeO₅ square pyramids, edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-27°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.74 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one SeO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-34°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.52 Å. There are two inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five O atoms to form SeO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight NaO₆ octahedra and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-73°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.72-1.80 Å. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to five O atoms to form SeO₅ square pyramids that share corners with eight NaO₆ octahedra and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-72°. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.73-1.81 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Se atom to form distorted ONa₅Se octahedra that share corners with three ONa₅Se octahedra, corners with two ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven ONa₅Se octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Se trigonal bipyramids.
